answer: Rank identities by trust flow from a seed set over the graph of paid interactions, SybilRank-style. A farmer's keys form an island: dense inside, but joined to honest agents by only the few edges he paid for, so trust leaking across that cut stays small no matter how many keys he adds. Rewards then step up a terrace of tiers, and reaching the zenith tier needs many distinct honest counterparties, each one a real trade costing him real work.
